_comment: H89 seam 3: the exit code. A control's escape is the success case and its catch is the failure; both directions are pinned on the one success set.
subject: exit 0 iff every row is CAUGHT or CONTROL-ESCAPED; CONTROL-CAUGHT exits 1

mutants.label: X1 CONTROL-ESCAPED is not a success
mutants.old_regex: (?<=in \{CAUGHT, CONTROL_ESCAPED\})(?= for row in rows\) else 1\n)

mutants.label: X2 CONTROL-CAUGHT is a success
mutants.old_regex: (?<=in \{CAUGHT, CONTROL_ESCAPED\})(?= for row in rows\) else 1\n)
